ValidationRule.description: If Employment Status = Self Employed then Business opeartions Starting date is a mandatory.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(cc_Employment_Status__c), ISPICKVAL(cc_Employment_Status__c, "Self Employed"), ISBLANK(cc_Business_Operations_Starting_Date__c), ($User.LastName <> "Integration"), OR( AND( ISPICKVAL(Type, "Credit Card Application"), ISPICKVAL(Sub_Type__c, "New Credit Card") ), ISPICKVAL(Type, "Credit Limit Increase Application"), ISPICKVAL(Type, "Convert Credit Card Nature Application") ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please fill the Business operations starting date field, if Employment status is Self Employed.
